title: HOLD-LC-001 targeted calibration provenance and posterior timing-coordinate audit
question: Do the hash-frozen GBM response products expose enough calibration provenance to refine the source-owner request, and does the selected LIGO posterior product contain a merger-time coordinate that could supply a timing likelihood for Delta_t_det?
method: Run the self-tested audit_hold_lc_calibration_metadata.py over exactly the two hash-frozen GBM response products and the selected low-spin LIGO posterior product.

Parse all scalar FITS header cards for the response products with quote-aware comment handling, recording creator/DRM, channel-to-energy conversion, gain correction and input-file provenance without reading response table values.

Read only the first non-empty gzip header line of the posterior product, verify its byte hash and length, and test for explicit time, geocent_time, tc, merger or coalescence coordinates without interpreting sample values.
Repeat the response calibration-field check and posterior schema/hash check with independent PowerShell code, and require a hostile mutation of a selected response hash to return nonzero.
Keep likelihood, covariance, intrinsic-lag nuisance, candidate maps, score and prospective credit stopped; preserve the existing T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods and owner order.

exact_scope.extraction_scope: Response FITS scalar headers and the posterior gzip schema header only; no response matrix values, event rows, posterior values, timing fit or score.
exact_scope.finite_scope: Finite source provenance/schema intake only; no continuum, physical identity or prospective validation.
exact_scope.method_scope: Additive T-061 source-owner intake; no change to T-054/T-059 methods, owner order or promotion firewalls.

detector_specific_fields: INFILE01 names the corresponding v00 PHA input
GAIN_COR is present for N0 and B0
GBMCKSUM is present for N0 and B0
gbm_response.interpretation: Calibration and response provenance/support metadata is present, but no timing uncertainty, geocenter conversion, joint likelihood or covariance is encoded by this audit.

ligo_posterior.interpretation: This exact posterior product cannot supply the GW merger-time coordinate needed for a source-owned Delta_t_det timing likelihood.

checks.detail: Quote-aware FITS header parsing, slash-in-string preservation and posterior schema token rules passed.
Both response products match their frozen SHA-256/byte lengths and expose creator/DRM/channel-energy provenance; the posterior hash/length matches and has no timing coordinate.
Independent PowerShell extraction found the creator, CH2E_VER, GAIN_COR and INFILE01 fields in both response products.
Independent PowerShell gzip read matched the posterior SHA-256/byte length, found all ten declared columns and found no timing coordinate.
Changing the expected SHA-256 of FERMI-GBM-N0-RESPONSE caused the audit command to return nonzero; the selected mutation was rejected.
No existing T-054/T-059 method authority, candidate card, result, negative, physical-empty input or Lean theorem was edited or promoted.

finding: The response products provide additional calibration provenance (GBM_RSP_Gen creator/version, DRM type, channel-to-energy conversion version, gain correction and source PHA input), which sharpens the request for the corresponding calibration release and validity intervals. The selected LIGO low-spin posterior product contains only distance, mass, tidal and spin columns and no merger-time coordinate. Neither observation supplies the source-owned timing likelihood, covariance or intrinsic-lag law required for candidate scoring.
decision_reason: This is a new exact-product schema and provenance audit, not a repeated generic search: a quote-aware parser, independent header/schema check and selected-hash hostile test delimit available calibration metadata from the missing statistical owner. The advance refines the owner request but cannot admit a likelihood, map, candidate, score or method change.
decision_scope: Finite retrospective response-header and posterior-schema extraction only; no event-level statistical inference, candidate ranking, dynamics identification, empirical prediction or physical promotion.
assumptions: The byte-freeze manifest remains the authority for product identity, hashes and remote locators.
Response header calibration fields are descriptive provenance and not a complete uncertainty model.
The posterior header line is a schema declaration; no posterior sample value is interpreted.
The selected response and posterior products are an intake subset, not a complete multi-detector timing analysis.
The existing candidate-neutral estimator contract, T-054/T-059 methods and prospective-lock rules remain controlling.
missing_assumptions: Source-owned calibration release and validity intervals linked to the response metadata.
Detector-to-geocenter timing conversion and uncertainty for both GW and GBM sides.
Frozen timing, background, detector and energy windows with selection semantics.
Joint timing likelihood or covariance including shared calibration/source terms.
Intrinsic-emission nuisance law or preregistered set-valued scoring rule.
Complete source-owned F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs maps and immutable scorer.

adversarial_review.check: Could a response matrix and gain correction be treated as a timing likelihood or covariance?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: the report records response provenance/support only; likelihood and covariance remain NOT_ADMITTED.

adversarial_review.check: Could the low-spin posterior be used as a GW merger-time distribution despite its schema?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: the exact header has no timing/geocent_time/tc coordinate and no sample values are reinterpreted.

adversarial_review.check: Could calibration version/gain fields be mistaken for calibration validity, geocenter correction or shared uncertainty?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: validity intervals, conversion implementation and covariance remain explicit missing assumptions.

adversarial_review.check: Could the two response files and one posterior product be called a complete timing pipeline?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED-FOR-SCOPE: the packet labels the exact finite intake subset and keeps F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs incomplete.

adversarial_review.check: Could this targeted audit replace the established proof lanes?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: T-054/T-059, owner order and parked-loop rules are unchanged and explicitly preserved.

boundary: EXP-001304 is a T0 source-provenance and schema advance. It does not admit a timing likelihood, covariance, nuisance law, F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map, candidate, score, prospective prediction, microscopic dynamics, physical identity, continuum result, Reading-H sign, Pre-A closure or mass-gap conclusion.
evidence_level: T0 exact byte/hash recheck, quote-aware response-header extraction, independent posterior-schema check and hostile selected-hash rejection; no model test
next_action: Use the response provenance fields to request or locate the matching calibration release/validity and timing-uncertainty owner artifacts. Do not infer a timing likelihood from response metadata or from a posterior product without a time coordinate; independently reproduce F_reg only after all required fields are frozen, while continuing unchanged T-054 owner intake.
stop_or_redesign: If no source owner supplies calibration validity, geocenter conversion and statistical objects, retain HOLD-LC-001 as provenance/design-only and do not score.
If a future parser reads response matrix or event values, issue a new version with an explicit candidate-neutral selection and error contract.
If a temporal observable is invariant over a static-equivalence class, report NONIDENTIFIABLE rather than selecting a representative.
If calibration, regulator or nuisance changes reverse a finite verdict, report UNSTABLE_FINITE_ONLY.
If the retrospective packet is used for tuning after target disclosure, do not award prospective credit.
non_claims: No candidate is admitted, selected, ranked, fitted or prospectively validated.
No source-owned likelihood, covariance, nuisance probability law or complete F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map is present.
Response calibration provenance does not establish a geocenter correction, causal law, QFT/Yang-Mills/gravity identity or microscopic dynamics.
Absence of a timing column in this exact posterior product does not prove that no other source product can provide one.
No physical vacuum, Reading-H branch, Pre-A, Sector-A, C6, A13, continuum, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything or mass-gap claim is established.
The existing T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods are unchanged; this audit is additive and not a replacement.
